From 1980 to 2010, the number of deaths among female centenarians increased from 4,668 to 18,222
The percentage of centenarian deaths among all deaths also increased, from 0.51% to 1.47% among females

the number of deaths among female centenarians ranged from three to five times higher than the number among males
Source: National Vital Statistics System. Mortality public use data files, 1980–2010.
As more persons in the United States reach the age of 100 years, the number of deaths of those aged ≥100 years has been increasing.
